Location 396 Ghala, Al Azaiba South, Post Box 1465, Muscat 130, OmanVIEW ON MAP

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

The Stock Custodian manages postal stock, financial-service supplies, and accountable postal assets for an assigned Military Post Office. This role maintains accurate inventory and financial accountability, processes transactions through U.S. Postal Service Point of Service/Retail Systems Software (POS/RSS), and ensures postal financial services operate in compliance with applicable USPS, Military Postal Service Agency (MPSA), Department of Defense, U.S. Air Force, installation, and contract requirements.

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.
Estimated Starting Salary Range for Stock Custodian: TBD
Full-time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.
q: Minimum of three (3) years of experience using USPS POS/RSS.
Minimum of three (3) years of experience managing postal financial services.
Demonstrated experience managing postal stock, conducting financial reconciliations, maintaining transaction records, and resolving inventory discrepancies.
Working knowledge of postal retail operations, postal financial instruments, customer-service transactions, and accountability requirements.
Strong attention to detail, mathematical accuracy, integrity, and recordkeeping discipline.
Ability to communicate clearly with customers, team members, military personnel, Government representatives, and company leadership.
Proficiency with standard computer applications, including Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and email.
Ability to meet all installation-specific access, medical, training, force-protection, and deployment requirements.
Mut pass pre-employment requirements of Cherokee Federal.
Experience supporting a Military Post Office, Army Post Office, Fleet Post Office, or other Department of Defense postal operation.
Experience supporting U.S. Air Force postal operations.
Knowledge of USPS, MPSA, DoD, and U.S. Air Force policies governing postal finance, stock custody, accountable items, money orders, and retail operations.
Experience operating in overseas, deployed, contingency, or austere environments.
Experience supporting financial audits, inspections, corrective-action plans, or quality-control reviews.
Experience with postal retail systems, cash handling, remittances, inventory management, and financial reporting.
